statement_details.original_statement: SELECT BusinessEntityID, FORMAT(ModifiedDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS FormattedModifiedDate, DATEDIFF(YEAR, BirthDate, GETDATE()) AS Age FROM Author WHERE DATEPART(YEAR, HireDate) = @HireDate;
